notes.title: Classic vs. Free Movement
notes.content:
This update is a bit experimental and based on feedback received from players.

One thing that keeps coming up in feedback is the missing diagonal movement. The game was designed with 4-way movement in mind, due to its maze-like environment, tactical pacing, and focus on precision shooting. However, many players have said this system can feel a bit limiting.

To test whether an alternative system could be fun—and possibly fit into the gameplay—an optional free movement system has now been added. It might still be rough around the edges, so keep that in mind.

[h2]How does it work?[/h2]
At the start of each run, the player can choose to switch to the alternative movement system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/4b61a257226d62b2d6a99fa1beea688859df74a8.png[/img]

This enables mouse control, strafing, and diagonal movement.
The gameplay changes drastically—it becomes much more action-based.
Still fun, but very different from the core experience.

If the player doesn’t select this option, the run starts with the classic 4-way movement.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/77c80a668eeb8628daec09d9f769f9d673adf804.png[/img]

[h2]Other changes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Performance issues have been fixed.
[*] Collision boxes have been fine-tuned, especially for fast-shoot mode. It just feels more natural when it comes to hitting the target.
[/list]

These changes are now live in the Demo version.
Try them out and share your thoughts!

[*]Properly tested Nintendo Switch controller support—works as expected (wired version only).

[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.1.6 released
notes.content:
[b]Version 1.0.6 Released![/b]

Additions:
[olist]

[*] Energy Gathering / Energy Levels
Players can now gather energy from destroyed enemies and power-ups. After destroying an enemy or collecting a power-up, particles will remain gatherable for a limited time. If the player picks them up, the energy level increases. Gathering energy unlocks features like an alternative weapon mode and awards extra points. The energy level resets at the start of each round.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/e14691133671220be53c7a5eb99d8129dba457ec.png[/img]

2. Alternative Weapon Mode
When a player gathers enough energy, an alternative weapon mode can be activated. Once activated, the energy level decreases at a predefined rate (10 energy per second). When energy runs out, the weapon switches back to its normal mode. Players can pick up more energy while in the alternative mode to extend its duration. Each mech has a unique alternative weapon mode.

3. Shield Status Indicator
A new indicator has been added to display shield status.

4. New Trailer is released!

Major Bug Fixes:

1. Fixed an issue where the player was invisible while using the operator ability.
2. Navigation for "Restart" and "Go to Menu" is now fixed on the Level Summary screen (Freerun mode).
3. Levels from Run mode are now properly registered as playable in Freerun mode.
4. Fine-tuned collision detection when players destroy the environment.
5. Resolved messaging issues in the tutorial.


In Progress (Not Included in This Release):
1. A third enemy type.
2. A second anomaly.
3. Power-downs that enemies can pick up.

notes.title: Version 0.1.04 released
notes.content:
Time for a new update!
Meet BX08 - Second Playable Pilot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/d245d72176ec40e0f0f567350f5e3139070653c6.png[/img]


I was thinking about implementing an ability that won’t directly deal damage or influence enemies, but rather something that enables tactics and controls the flow of the match (e.g. retreating, redirecting enemies, setting up traps).

Here’s how it works:

1. The pilot selects the locations for the first and second teleport and summons them.
2. Afterward, the teleports become connected, so anything that enters one comes out the other (and vice versa).
3. This enables interesting tactics, like placing a teleport near enemies and waiting by the second, or even shooting through the teleport.
4. The initial direction of a projectile is preserved after teleportation. So, if you stand directly in front of the teleport, the projectile will continue moving forward after it teleports.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/3ee29a584959e41cc733196d90a54f14023c45a5.png[/img]

5. The same applies for back, right, and left directions. This works for everything, including the first pilot’s ability (controllable projectile), which can be nicely combined in co-op play.
6. As with every pilot ability, it temporarily disables the mech, making it extra vulnerable. Therefore, it should be used from a safe spot (though "safe" is subjective—there are no safe spots in Decurion!).

The second update in this build is the Shield. I designed it to give players a better chance of surviving tough situations, but it requires some skill.
The shield summons immediately and will absorb one projectile, after which it disappears and becomes available again after a short cooldown.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/fcd56fa754d9d909881de7998a13c4c818cd1d38.png[/img]

It costs nothing, works quickly, and allows players to take extra risks and escape dangerous situations unharmed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/e299ed1d6c4a3688fa1d0ab772b8785c0aa2b0b6.png[/img]

If activated right before impact, the shield will deflect the projectile back to the enemy. This only works against projectiles!

That’s all for this update! Stay tuned!

notes.title: Local coop!
notes.content:
Time for a new update, which is one of the most important ones so far. In this version, I've added a local co-op mode (couch co-op).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/e5617faa11c8371afc477c9e26d70c130441849a.png[/img]

It's now possible to go through every level in run mode together, sharing all the fun (and the pain).

There isn't much selection in terms of Mechs and Pilots at the moment, so both players start with the default options.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/6cbaf2135034d1c1c8386ccc4f628f94a221ba8e.png[/img]

As for controls, the setup is as follows: keyboard for Player 1 and controller for Player 2. Support for two controllers or two keyboards is in progress.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/7dfd32c4ca45331e8b971f345d5acdbcbf2d7c32.png[/img]

This is how the level summary looks like now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/ab2ef0f98204bfde5cc6c1f4309af17f8c49468a.png[/img]

I did a lot of refactoring in this update and fixed tons of bugs related to the co-op logic. It’s finally done, and I’m very proud of the result!

The next update will contain:

- Second playable pilot

- Freeplay mode and scoreboard for the couch coop mode

That`s about it for today, if you have suggestion or find any bug please let me know! Until the next time!

notes.title: New content is added
notes.content:
Things that were added in this build:

[list]

[*] Fourth level: In this level, I introduced a new tile type that will push everyone in a certain direction (indicated with arrows). This will be more dynamic in future releases as tiles will be shuffled every X amount of time.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/f0d148adb2531feee9a37077f86be87136ac7d11.png[/img]

[*] Finalized localization: It was a very tedious task, but it’s done! Players can choose the language at first launch or via the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/674f161502dbda3723419df223fa91bce2e7c9d8.png[/img]
 
[*] Power-up message: Added a message that will pop up after any power-up is picked. I've received some feedback about this; a few people were constantly complaining about not understanding what they had picked.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44826505/8e69e00a7070838601da83cc289155c9723e7cda.png[/img]

[*] Fine-tuned tutorial level: Added extra explanation in the step where the player has to use the pilot ability, thanks to feedback.
 
[*] Retry button: Added a retry run button on the game over screen. This will be used a lot.
 
[*] Improved sound effects: Finally found a good sound for steps and running. The mech no longer sounds like someone is banging an anvil with a hammer.
 
[*] Minor design fixes: Made some minor design fixes in terms of the color palette.
[/list]
That’s about it for this build!
